---
name: Feature Request (Epic)
about: Propose a new feature or epic that requires multiple sub-tasks
title: "Epic: <short title of the feature>"
labels: epic, enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature or epic you are proposing.

## Motivation / Problem Statement

Why is this feature important? What problem does it solve, and for whom?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you would like to see. Include design ideas, API
sketches, or UX flows where relevant.

## Alternatives Considered

A clear description of any alternative solutions or features you have
considered.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Requirement 1
- [ ] Requirement 2
- [ ] Requirement 3

## Priority

> Indicate priority by including one of these keywords in the body:
> `critical`, `urgent`, `production`, `outage` (critical) ·
> `important`, `high`, `blocking` (high) ·
> `medium`, `normal` (medium) ·
> `low`, `nice-to-have`, `minor` (low)

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, mockups, or references about the feature
request here.
